release_checks.check: Record stage identifier and root parity evidence; hash tested source and compare with shipped source after fixes.
Exactly twenty fixed questions, three lives, fourteen short questions, and six layered questions at 6, 9, 11, 15, 17, 20.
Compare actual menu, ordinary questions, game over, and certificate at 1366x768 and 1920x1080; inspect native 550x400 stage for clipping and density.
Record the visible clue for each page-object action; no solution in accessibility names, hidden labels, comments, or free correctness responses.
Every enabled object/control does its advertised job; meaningful actions commit naturally; no universal ANSWER or green/red free verifier.
Mouse drag and keyboard alternatives agree; drag release suppresses accidental clicks; rapid double click cannot apply to the next question.
Reload retains acknowledged and pending drafts and manual notes; menu return/resume works; dialogs preserve focus and notes.
Only player notes and acquired artifacts appear; no automatic answer summaries. Actual backup and denial-strip bytes remain downloadable and recoverable.
Attempt title music on load, catch autoplay denial, retry on first pointer or keyboard interaction. Retain original files, saved mute/levels, sensible track changes and non-silent playback evidence.
Reach controls and evidence using keyboard; visible focus, dialog Escape/trap/restore, readable labels, reduced motion, and no exclusive reliance on audio or animation.
Three wrong committed actions show original game-over; retry resets fixed Q1 state, three lives, no question progress/skips; notes and legitimately acquired retained artifacts follow approved rules.
No early save warning. Earn exactly three skips at 5, 10, 15. Spending one advances normally but cannot certify; final feedback explains unmet requirements without leaking PIN.
Public solve reaches certificate, all nineteen prior completions and three unspent earned skips are required, and final consume happens once. Recover certificate after reload and menu return.
Record browser errors, failed asset requests, and abnormal action responses during the actual solve.
Root-owned walkthrough and captures reflect this revision, use actual control names, and accurately explain essential reasoning; Word rendering and links are separately checked.
Any passive anti-agent metadata stays outside required evidence, execution, labels, and notebook; normal scripts and accessibility remain usable; effectiveness remains unproven.
